_meta.software: umap-learn 0.6.0 (PyPI release), optimizer=adam, compatibility_layout=False, n_neighbors=15, min_dist=0.1
_meta.target: E95_best / q = recall15 / best fixed-budget recall15 (PREDICTIONS_v2.md)

grow_rule.description: Stage 1 uses UMAP's Adam learning-rate schedule for a run of stages[0] epochs; stage k>=2 continues the same embedding and Adam state with rho * UMAP's schedule for stages[k] epochs. After each stage k>=2, stop if monitor recall r_k < (1 + tau) * r_{k-1}. Return the embedding of the stage with the highest r.

monitor.neighbors: UMAP's own input kNN table (self in column 0) vs the same number of embedding neighbors

v3_spectral.assumption: n plus spectral gap within connected components and number of components (2-D output only)

features.lambda_conn: smallest eigenvalue > 1e-6 of the symmetric normalized Laplacian of UMAP's fuzzy graph (12 smallest computed by eigsh)
features.K: number of connected components of that graph
